clock.gettime.note: day, month, year-2000, hour, minute, second. fujinet-lib clock_get_time() writes buf[6] = 0 (fuji_clock.c:51): the C buffer is 7 bytes

clock.settz_alt2.trap: 54H is the simple-time GETTER on RS232: the read table claims it before the write table (fujiClock.cpp:350-352, 385-390, 406-409); fujinet-lib's SIMPLE_BINARY uses it

clock.get_iso_local.note: +0000 with the rig's system TZ UTC

clock.gettz_len.note: 04 ("UTC" + NUL). No fujinet-lib call: C uses fuji_bus_call

clock.get_general.note: "UTC\0". C's clock_get_tz() sends GETTZ_LEN (4CH) first, then GET_GENERAL: two exchanges

clock.settz.note: alternate TZ CST6CDT,M3.2.0,M11.1.0 (RAM only). asm sends no field + the TZ; C's clock_get_time_tz() sends two u8 fields (length, ignored) + the TZ, then GETTIME with alt=1

clock.gettztime.note: the alternate zone (UTC-5 in October). No fujinet-lib call: C uses fuji_bus_call

clock.get_iso_utc.alt.note: +0000: the alt field is accepted and ignored (fujiClock.cpp:300-303)

clock.settz_alt.note: system TZ EST5EDT,M3.2.0,M11.1.0, saved to fnconfig.ini (fujiClock.cpp:315-326)

clock.settz_alt.bad.trap: ACK is sent before validation; a TZ with a byte outside 20H-7EH (here a CR) is silently dropped (fujiClock.cpp:152-162, 212, 317-321); fujinet.log says "Rejecting malformed timezone"

clock.get_general.kept.note: still EST5EDT: the bad TZ was ignored
